_note: Sources for Form 4 Maths (content/classes.json, form-4). Rules are computed by src/engine/lib/maths.js and maths2.js (poly, mono, quad, lin2, surd).

algebra-expand.ref: Form 4 Mathematics syllabus, Term 1, Algebraic processes: expansion of expressions; identities (a ± b)², (a + b)(a − b)
algebra-expand.checked: Answers computed by the engine from the distributive law; checked by 1000-seed tests.

algebra-factorise.ref: Form 4 Mathematics syllabus, Term 1, Algebraic processes: factorisation by grouping, difference of two squares, sum and difference of two cubes, quadratic trinomials
algebra-factorise.checked: Answers computed by the engine; every factorisation is the expansion of the answer, checked by 1000-seed tests.

quadratic-equations.ref: Form 4 Mathematics syllabus, Term 1, Algebraic processes: solving quadratic equations by factorisation, completing the square and the quadratic formula; forming equations from roots
quadratic-equations.checked: Roots computed by the engine (factors, completed square, formula); every root is substituted back by the 1000-seed tests.

polynomials.ref: Form 4 Mathematics syllabus, Term 1, Algebraic processes: long division with algebraic expressions; factor and remainder theorems; factorising polynomials of degree 3; solving cubic equations
polynomials.checked: Quotients, remainders and roots computed by the engine (cval, synthetic division); every root is substituted back by the 1000-seed tests.

inequalities.ref: Form 4 Mathematics syllabus, Term 1, Equations and inequations: interval notation, linear inequalities in one unknown, absolute value equations and inequalities, quadratic inequalities
inequalities.checked: Solution sets computed by the engine (interval, intsIn, sign of factors); checked by 1000-seed tests.

graphs.ref: Form 4 Mathematics syllabus, Term 1, Equations and inequations: graphical solutions of simultaneous linear equations, linear inequalities (half planes) and simultaneous inequalities; graphs of quadratic functions; the discriminant; graphical solution of quadratic equations
graphs.checked: Graphs drawn by graphFig from the same numbers as the answers; crossings, regions (lattice) and roots computed by the engine; checked by 1000-seed tests.
